Pretty cool, right? Thank you so much for watching. If you have any questions, use that comment section down below. Don't forget to like, and subscribe, check out our YouTube channel. Lots of great videos, for you to watch and keep having fun in Clo.
markdown_content: ## GPU Rendering on macOS in CLO 2025.0 This section explains the new GPU rendering feature introduced in CLO 2025.0 on macOS, highlighting how users can leverage GPU acceleration for faster rendering of 3D garments and scenes. In CLO 2025.0, users can now select GPU rendering directly within the render settings on macOS, which significantly improves rendering speed compared to CPU-only rendering. To enable this, open CLO on macOS and navigate to the **Render** menu on the top toolbar. Within the **Render Settings**, there is a dropdown menu labeled **Engine** where you can choose **GPU** as the rendering device. Additional options include enabling CPU support alongside GPU rendering and adjusting GPU priority loads to optimize performance based on your hardware capabilities. Once GPU rendering is selected, start the render process by clicking the **Play** button. The rendering completes much faster, delivering high-quality images efficiently. This feature empowers CLO users on macOS to achieve quicker and visually appealing renders by utilizing the GPU, enhancing workflow speed especially when working with complex garments or scenes. --- ## Using GPU Rendering Settings in CLO This section details the procedure for selecting and configuring GPU rendering options within CLO 2025.0, including CPU support and GPU priority adjustments. To access GPU rendering: 1. Open your project in CLO on macOS. 2. Go to the top toolbar and select **Render > Render Settings**. 3. In the **Engine** dropdown, select **GPU**. 4. Optionally, enable **CPU support** if you wish to utilize both CPU and GPU for rendering. 5. Adjust **GPU priority load** settings if available to balance system resources. 6. Click **Play** to start rendering. This workflow allows users to customize rendering performance based on their system hardware and project requirements. The integration of GPU rendering supports faster image generation while maintaining high-quality visual output. --- ## Performance Benefits of GPU Rendering in CLO This section highlights the speed and quality improvements users can expect when using GPU rendering in CLO 2025.0 on macOS. GPU rendering in CLO drastically reduces render times compared to CPU-only methods. Users report significantly faster speeds, enabling rapid iteration and visualization of designs. The rendered images maintain high fidelity, producing visually rich and detailed outputs suitable for presentations and design evaluations. By leveraging GPU acceleration, CLO users on macOS can improve productivity and streamline their design-to-render workflows, especially beneficial for complex garments or scenes requiring high computational resources. --- ## Summary CLO 2025.0 introduces GPU rendering support on macOS, enabling users to select GPU as the rendering engine within Render Settings. This feature accelerates rendering speed while maintaining image quality, with options to enable CPU support and adjust GPU priority. The update enhances the rendering workflow, allowing faster, high-quality image generation for fashion design projects.
